svg.title: Setting up self-host in 30 seconds
svg.desc: A terminal window plays the whole setup. It installs with curl -fsSL https://self-host.fyi/install | bash, answers Onboarding one question at a time (Welcome, What, Where, Access, Who, Look), shows the Review plan and presses enter to approve, then lands on the Dashboard Overview with Homarr, Jellyfin, Prowlarr, qBittorrent, Radarr, Seerr and Sonarr running. A strip of four steps above it ticks off as it goes.
